featured_reviews.name: Ahmed Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're still paying premium prices for branded medicines, it's time to rethink—and Zeelab Pharmacy is the perfect place to start. Their range of generic medicines offers the same salt, same dosage, and same effectiveness as branded drugs, all approved by the CENTRAL DRUG STANDARD CONTROL ORGANIZATION (CDSCO), India’s top regulatory authority for pharmaceuticals.

So why the price difference?
It’s not about quality—it’s about branding. Big-name companies charge more due to their brand value and marketing costs. Zeelab cuts through that noise and delivers affordable healthcare without compromising safety or efficacy.

Don’t fear generic medicine.
It’s time to change the mentality that cheap means risky. Generic medicines are scientifically equivalent and legally approved. By choosing Zeelab, you’re choosing smart healthcare—protecting your health and your wallet.

Spread the word. Let’s normalize generic medicine and make healthcare truly accessible for all.

featured_reviews.name: Paweł K
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're ever in Mumbai and in need of a reliable pharmacy, A Plus Pharmacy is the place to go. From the moment you step inside (for me it was by WhatsApp), it’s clear that customer service is a top priority. The staff is exceptionally friendly and attentive, always ready to help you find exactly what you need.

Ordering process is quick and efficient. Whether you're making an in-person purchase or ordering online, the system is seamless. the staff is more than happy to place an order for you and ensure it arrives as quickly as possible.

The quality of products at A Plus Pharmacy is excellent. They stock a wide range of medications, health supplements, and personal care products, all carefully stored and well-maintained. You can trust that the products are genuine and safe, with clear expiration dates and proper storage conditions.

Overall, A Plus Pharmacy is a fantastic option for anyone in Mumbai. With its excellent service, efficient ordering process, and attention to product quality, I can confidently say that you’ll be returning here whenever you need a pharmacy. Highly recommend it!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Dhebar
featured_reviews.review_text: This pharmacy is close to a number of hotels and whilst I was unwell, I needed few medications delivered to me. I am very happy with their service - very efficient, good prices, delivered straight to the hotel very quickly. When they didn’t have a products, they sourced them and delivered them as soon as possible. They communicated very clearly, very pleased with the service and would recommend them and use them again. Thanks for your service.

featured_reviews.name: Kanushree Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Just amazing!! They are super responsive and fast with delivery. If you know what medications you are looking for, they are the go to pharmacy as they have everything in stock. They deliver asap and communicate well. Thank you for your incredible services! 🙏🦋💫
